petersen:1866.author: Julius Petersen
petersen:1866.title: Methoder og Theorier til Løsning af geometriske Konstruktionsopgaver, anvendte paa ca. 400 Opgaver
petersen:1866.note: First Danish edition of Petersen's treatise on geometric construction heuristics.

petersen:1879.author: Julius Petersen (trans. Sophus Haagensen)
petersen:1879.title: Methods and Theories for the Solution of Problems of Geometrical Constructions, Applied to 410 Problems
petersen:1879.publisher: Andr. Fred. Høst & Son, Copenhagen / Sampson Low, Marston, Searle & Rivington, London
petersen:1879.note: Authorized English edition from the expanded 2nd Danish edition (102 pages, 410 problems).

petersen:1871.author: Julius Petersen
petersen:1871.title: Om Ligninger, der løses ved Kvadratrod
petersen:1871.note: Petersen's doctoral thesis on algebraic equations solvable by square roots, cited in the Appendix (p. 98).

petersen:1878.author: Julius Petersen
petersen:1878.title: Theorie der algebraischen Gleichungen
petersen:1878.note: German edition of Petersen's treatise on Galois theory and quadratic constructibility, cited on p. 98.

petersen:1891.author: Julius Petersen
petersen:1891.title: Die Theorie der regulären graphs
petersen:1891.note: Foundational paper of modern graph theory.

euclid:elements.author: Euclid (trans. Sir Thomas L. Heath)
euclid:elements.title: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid:elements.note: Canonical axiomatic foundation of compass-and-straightedge geometry (GEOMETOR euclid & elements).

pappus:synagoge.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:synagoge.title: Synagoge (Mathematical Collection), Book VII — Domain of Analysis
pappus:synagoge.note: Classical formulation of geometric analysis and synthesis, harmonic ranges, and Apollonius's lost Tangencies and Plane Loci (GEOMETOR pappus).

steiner:1826.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner:1826.title: Einige geometrische Betrachtungen
steiner:1826.publisher: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle) 1, 161–184
steiner:1826.note: Introduces power of a point, radical axes, centres of similitude, and Steiner's construction of Malfatti's circles.

schroeter:1874.author: Heinrich Schröter
schroeter:1874.title: Die Steinersche Auflösung der Malfattischen Aufgabe
schroeter:1874.publisher: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle) 77, 230–244
schroeter:1874.note: First proof of Steiner's Malfatti construction via circle inversions, simplified by Petersen in 1879 (pp. 96–97).

wantzel:1837.author: Pierre Laurent Wantzel
wantzel:1837.title: Recherches sur les moyens de reconnaître si un problème de Géométrie peut se résoudre avec la règle et le compas
wantzel:1837.publisher: Journal de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées 2, 366–372
wantzel:1837.note: First rigorous proof of the impossibility of trisecting the general angle and duplicating the cube.

lindemann:1882.author: Ferdinand von Lindemann
lindemann:1882.title: Über die Zahl pi
lindemann:1882.note: Proved the transcendence of pi three years after Petersen's remark on p. 101 of the 1879 English edition.

lemoine:1902.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine:1902.title: Géométrographie, ou Art des constructions géométriques
lemoine:1902.note: Operational complexity calculus for Euclidean constructions (GEOMETOR lemoine).

klein:1895.author: Felix Klein
klein:1895.title: Vorträge über ausgewählte Fragen der Elementargeometrie
klein:1895.publisher: B. G. Teubner, Leipzig (English trans. Famous Problems of Elementary Geometry, 1897)
klein:1895.note: Classic synthesis of straightedge-and-compass, compass-only, and transcendental constructibility.

hilbert:1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1899.title: Grundlagen der Geometrie
hilbert:1899.note: Axiomatic foundation of geometry and Chapter VII gauge-and-straightedge constructibility criteria (GEOMETOR hilbert).

altshiller_court:1952.author: Nathan Altshiller-Court
altshiller_court:1952.title: College Geometry: An Introduction to the Modern Geometry of the Triangle and the Circle (2nd ed.)
altshiller_court:1952.note: Standard modern synthetic geometry treatise directly extending Petersen's Chapter I–III methods (GEOMETOR altshiller-court).

polya:1962.author: George Pólya
polya:1962.title: Mathematical Discovery: On Understanding, Learning, and Teaching Problem Solving (Vol. I)
polya:1962.note: Chapters 1 and 2 build heuristic pedagogy directly around Petersen's Pattern of Two Loci and Pattern of Similar Figures.
